svg.title: Vetrix Staff data flow diagram
svg.desc: 3.1 Register clients and pets; 3.2 Schedule appointments; 3.3 Process orders and payments; 3.4 Manage inventory; 3.5 Retrieve pet records by QR. Labeled arrows show data exchanged with logical stores.
svg.text: Data flow diagram • Simplified Level 1 role view
Booking decision, date and assigned vet
Sale details, payment review and order
Rectangle = user • Rounded box = process • Divided box = data store • Arrow = direction of data
Repeated users and store IDs refer to the same entity or store. Rows show data flows, not a sequence of steps.
Selected business processes. Authentication and routine logging are omitted.
